narrative_prose: Ryn clutches her heavy brass ladle, squinting at the swirling dark of the underground cavern where the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea rips the obsidian surface into jagged peaks. The acrid smell of ozone and metallic dust fills the starkly cold air, accompanied by the whooshing, cracking hum of magnetic fields that bite her ears. A subtle static tang coats the back of her tongue. She stands ready to DEFEND the console. She maneuvers the field to ATTRACT metallic debris. She attempts to CONSUME the crystallized fungus node for energy. She hands the physical brass ladle to Silas.
